structured.answer: I'll ask my son or the bank. As far as I understood, the basic package costs up to 10 ₪ a month, and from 01.10.2026 the fee is capped (5 ₪ for up to two actions, 10 ₪ for up to a hundred). Only money that might go out soon should sit in the current account, because it earns 0% and 10,000 ₪ becomes worth 8,203 ₪ in ten years.
